message:
Cottage windows rarely behave like a standard new-build casement.

They can be short and wide, deep in stone, slightly out of square, or a mix of old timber and newer uPVC in the same house.

Curtains often eat the sill. Stock shutters rarely fit.

We’ve written a practical guide on what actually works: café-style for privacy with daylight above, full-height when the room is overlooked, materials for damp vs dry rooms, and honest 2026 cost ranges for a typical small opening.

Read it here → https://shutter-envy.co.uk/cottage-window-shutters-uk-buyers-guide/

Based in Melton Mowbray. Free home survey across Leicestershire.
